groups.title: Pre-build
groups.purpose: Used by the planner to understand the work, explore the idea and write the plan.

groups.title: Build
groups.purpose: Guide the executor and its agents while they implement the plan. The planner offers the development skills; only those the user picks reach the plan.

groups.title: Post-build
groups.purpose: The user invokes these after the implementation is done. They never run on their own.

groups.title: Extras
groups.purpose: Useful skills the user invokes by hand when needed. They never run on their own.

skills.name: planner
skills.author: pihouse
skills.summary: Leads the user from an idea to a validated plan and hands it to the executor.

skills.name: grilling
skills.author: Matt Pocock
skills.summary: The grill-me step: interviews the user one decision at a time to stress-test the idea.

skills.name: executor
skills.author: pihouse
skills.summary: Runs a validated plan end to end with agent-link agents, without asking the user.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Write a failing test, make the smallest change that passes, verify.
skills.offerWhen: the work changes behavior that tests can pin down

skills.name: spec-driven-development
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Define expected behavior and acceptance criteria before implementing.
skills.offerWhen: no spec exists yet, or the behavior is new

skills.name: source-driven-development
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Research the code, docs and sources first and ground decisions in them.
skills.offerWhen: the work depends on a framework, API or library behavior

skills.name: security-and-hardening
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Review threats, validation, permissions and safe data handling.
skills.offerWhen: the work touches input, auth, secrets or user data

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Measure and improve the performance problems that matter.
skills.offerWhen: there is a performance goal or a suspected regression

skills.name: doubt-driven-development
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Put assumptions and decisions to an adversarial check with evidence.
skills.offerWhen: the work rests on risky or untested assumptions

skills.name: constraint-driven-development
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Turn constraints into concrete, checked quality criteria.
skills.offerWhen: there are quality bars to hold (coverage, size, latency)

skills.name: documentation-and-adrs
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Update docs or record decisions as ADRs when it applies.
skills.offerWhen: the work changes public APIs or makes a lasting decision

skills.name: observability-and-instrumentation
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Add the logs, metrics and traces that explain behavior and diagnose failures.
skills.offerWhen: the code runs in production or is hard to debug

skills.name: incremental-implementation
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Split large work into thin, verifiable increments.
skills.offerWhen: the work touches several files or modules

skills.name: git-workflow-and-versioning
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Follow Git and versioning practices.
skills.offerWhen: the user chose GitHub-related work (branches, PRs, releases)

skills.name: ci-cd-and-automation
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Change pipelines, checks or automation.
skills.offerWhen: the user chose CI/CD or automation work

skills.name: shipping-and-launch
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Prepare a production launch: checklist, rollout, monitoring and rollback.

skills.name: handoff
skills.author: Matt Pocock
skills.summary: Write a handoff document so another agent or session can continue the work.

skills.name: api-and-interface-design
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Design clear API contracts and interfaces.

skills.name: browser-testing-with-devtools
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Test browser flows with developer tools.

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Review changes for defects, risks and maintainability.

skills.name: debugging-and-error-recovery
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Find the root cause of failures and improve recovery.

skills.name: code-simplification
skills.author: Addy
skills.summary: Reduce complexity without changing behavior.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.author: Paul Bakaus
skills.summary: Improve frontend design and visual quality: critique, polish, typography, layout, motion.

skills.name: keeper
skills.author: pihouse
skills.summary: The workflow-memory keeper: counts pending runs, digests them on request and handles proposals.
